description: Behavior cases for export QA strategy: staged contracts, dataset/edge coverage, partial-failure recovery, idempotency, tenant isolation and expected-result evidence.

cases.prompt: Design the QA strategy for our tenant data export: users request an archive, we authorize and scope it, redact, build, deliver and expire the link.

assertions: Defines checks for every stage authorize/scope/build/redact/deliver/expire/audit with a stated expected result per check.
Builds a dataset/edge matrix including malformed, large-volume, tenant-boundary and expiry cases.
Defines partial-failure, idempotency/replay and delivery-expiry verification cases, and tenant-isolation checks for exported rows/links.
Hands implementation to export-pipeline-architect and claims no implementation or production execution.

cases.prompt: Our export has tests but no evidence for redaction, duplicate delivery or expiry. Define the export QA strategy and evidence.

assertions: Produces an expected-result evidence table naming an observable proof for every check.
Covers duplicate/replay, partial delivery and expired-link failure with expected outcomes.
States untested edges and limitations rather than claiming complete coverage.

cases.prompt: The export can deliver some files before a failure. What should QA verify about partial delivery and recovery?

assertions: Defines partial-delivery policy and verifies per-file recovery or documented retry/rollback.
Defines idempotent replay behavior and duplicate-delivery prevention with expected results.
Verifies interruption/failure leaves a recorded recoverable state, not silent partial export.

cases.prompt: Define the testing strategy for our whole product across all teams and release gates.

assertions: Product-wide QA strategy is qa-strategy-architect job; export QA strategy only covers export verification.
